# IAccessible2 selection interfaces

Upstream: LinuxA11y/IAccessible2, commit c9ae003d9c85eb707716928de97e055f5b77189c.

`SelectionInterfaces.h` retains the C++ COM declarations generated by Windows SDK
10.0.26100 MIDL from Accessible2, AccessibleAction, AccessibleText,
AccessibleHyperlink, AccessibleHypertext and their shared types. C bindings and
RPC stubs are omitted. UUIDs, base interfaces, method order and argument types
are unchanged. No proxy DLL or browser extension is installed.

The BSD license is retained in the header and packaged as `licenses/IAccessible2.txt`.
